academic-skill.short_description: Plan, write, check sources, study and present
academic-skill.prompt_nb: Hjelp meg å forstå oppgaven, sjekke belegget og planlegge en presentasjon.
academic-skill.prompt_en: Help me interpret my brief, check my evidence and plan a presentation.

academic-core.short_description: Turn an assignment and rubric into a plan
academic-core.prompt_nb: Gjør vurderingskriteriene om til tre konkrete krav jeg kan skrive etter.
academic-core.prompt_en: Turn my assignment and rubric into a practical writing plan.

personal-voice.short_description: Preserve your voice using your own writing
personal-voice.prompt_nb: Finn to trekk i mine egne skriveprøver som jeg kan beholde i revisjonen.
personal-voice.prompt_en: Which two features of my own writing should I keep in this revision?

academic-writing.short_description: Build an argument from your draft and evidence
academic-writing.prompt_nb: Hjelp meg å knytte sitatet i dette avsnittet til problemstillingen.
academic-writing.prompt_en: Connect this paragraph’s evidence to my thesis.

humanizer.short_description: Copyedit for clarity, flow and an accurate meaning
humanizer.prompt_nb: Språkvask dette avsnittet. Behold tallene, sitatene og forbeholdet.
humanizer.prompt_en: Copyedit my paragraph and keep its numbers, quotations and qualifications.

academic-critic.short_description: Give specific feedback against marking criteria
academic-critic.prompt_nb: Læreren ber om mer drøfting. Vis hvor utkastet trenger en innvending.
academic-critic.prompt_en: Review my draft against the rubric and locate the most important revision.

research-integrity.short_description: Check each claim against the available evidence
research-integrity.prompt_nb: Sjekk hver påstand mot dette utdraget. Oppgi hva kilden faktisk støtter.
research-integrity.prompt_en: Check each claim against the supplied source and flag what remains uncertain.

learning-coach.short_description: Learn a concept through a worked example and practice
learning-coach.prompt_nb: Forklar forskjellen på påstand og belegg. La meg så prøve selv.
learning-coach.prompt_en: Teach me the difference between a claim and evidence, then let me try.

exam-preparation.short_description: Practice exams, flashcards and one-question quizzes
exam-preparation.prompt_nb: Quiz meg til muntlig eksamen med ett spørsmål om gangen fra notatene.
exam-preparation.prompt_en: Quiz me on my notes, one question at a time.

presentation-engine.short_description: Plan evidence, slides and speaking time
presentation-engine.prompt_nb: Gjør funnene mine om til en presentasjon på fire minutter med talepunkter.
presentation-engine.prompt_en: Turn my findings into a four-minute talk with speaker notes.

office-integration.short_description: Work with academic Word, Excel and PowerPoint files
office-integration.prompt_nb: Bruk celleområdet fra Excel til å sjekke resultatavsnittet mitt.
office-integration.prompt_en: Check whether my results paragraph matches the supplied Excel range.

quality-assurance.short_description: Check the final text against the brief and sources
quality-assurance.prompt_nb: Kontroller sitater, tall, forbehold og oppgavekrav før innlevering.
quality-assurance.prompt_en: Check my final draft for changes in quotations, numbers and scope.
